_comment: Accepted parity residuals on the qrcodes_v3 regression set. Each
entry is a category name -> { delta_pp, tolerance_pp, reason } where
delta_pp is the empirically-measured cpp - java decode-rate delta
(originally measured at the 9b close-out, commit 70f8617; aggregate
tightened from -0.08pp to 0.00pp in cycle 3 / commit 23c1327, but
the per-category residuals listed here are independent of the
homography fix and remain unchanged). tolerance_pp is the band
around that delta within which run_regression.sh treats the residual
as accepted (NOT a regression). Categories not listed are gated at
the strict +/-2pp CLAUDE.md band.
Provenance: see docs/decisions/06_threshold_block_otsu_audit.md for
the empirical root-cause attribution of the monitor/glare residuals
(IEEE-754 floating-point accumulation noise in ComputeOtsu's histogram
sums causes 0.6-1.9% edge-wandering at fg/bg boundaries; cycle B's
verbatim contour port confirmed this is upstream, not contour-stage).
ADR 05 (cycles A+B + initial re-attribution), ADR 01 (original
cv::findContours hypothesis, now disproven), and src/decoder/
qr_code_decoder_image.md 'Known parity residuals' section have full
history. Update this file ONLY when an ADR is updated to reflect a
new accepted state.

monitor.reason: ThresholdBlockOtsu IEEE-754 edge-wandering. Current taxonomy: Java decodes image011/image012 before C++ has a decoder candidate and image014 where C++ reaches ERROR_CORRECTION; C++ decodes image017 where Java does not, so the net residual is -2/17 = -11.76pp. Audit measured 0.602% per-pixel binary diff vs Java on image011, 100% within 1px of fg/bg boundary, 0% interior. See ADR 06 and ResearchLog 2026-05-12.

glare.reason: ThresholdBlockOtsu IEEE-754 edge-wandering. Current taxonomy: Java decodes image005/image022 before C++ has a decoder candidate; image007 is not a Java/C++ delta in the current locked baselines. Net residual is -2/53 = -3.77pp. Audit measured 1.884% per-pixel binary diff vs Java on image005, 100% within 1px of fg/bg boundary, 0% interior. See ADR 06 and ResearchLog 2026-05-12.

bright_spots.reason: Small-N noise + cv::findContours interaction: +2/97 GT past Java baseline. Allow some headroom.

noncompliant.reason: Small-N (26 GT): a single image swing = 3.85pp. Within denominator-noise band.

high_version.reason: Small-N (37 GT): a single image swing = 2.70pp.

perspective.reason: Small-N (35 GT): a single image swing = 2.86pp.
